conversations.content: 我们先不管这个了我们现在开始做加赛部分的题吧

我们继续做加赛题吧，[https://oceanbase.yuque.com/org-wiki-obtech-vh7w9r/hc3pio/vzt7rbh4125g18wx](https://oceanbase.yuque.com/org-wiki-obtech-vh7w9r/hc3pio/vzt7rbh4125g18wx)在文档里有任何可以借助的东西，一定要和我获取

experiments.output: sql_crud: PASS; sql_comparisons: PASS; sql_ordering: PASS; sql_empty: PASS; sql_primary_key: PASS; sql_unicode: PASS; sql_bigint: PASS; sql_unsupported: PASS; storage_restart: PASS; vector_euclidean: PASS; transaction_commit: PASS; transaction_rollback: PASS; storage_mutations: PASS; storage_multiple_tables: PASS; vector_ties_and_filter: PASS; vector_float32: PASS; vector_index_maintenance: PASS; transaction_failed_insert: PASS; transaction_autocommit_atomic: PASS; transaction_shutdown_rollback: PASS
PASS: two process kills, committed rows recovered, uncommitted and failed rows absent
PASS: exact matches 24 independent TopK results, ANN recall=1.000, elapsed=0.067s

Seed 38, 10000 rows × 128 float32 dimensions, 16 evenly distributed labels, 48 exact Top10 queries per group, one warm-up query per run, three paired trials. Median filtered seconds: 0.4773 → 0.0734. Median unfiltered seconds: 1.0888 → 1.0736. The returned IDs matched the baseline in all trials. This run measured local wall time, without the official cgroup I/O or memory measurements.

24 indexed exact TopK queries matched an independently sorted float32 reference. ANN average recall was 1.000 for that fixture. An equality bucket reflected an uncommitted update, was restored on rollback, and reflected a subsequent committed update and deletion. After two forced process exits, committed rows remained and uncommitted or failed rows were absent.

experiments.source: 2026-11-15 public mysqltest manifest via a local Windows pipe adapter
experiments.output: 20/20 case assertions passed, including vector filters and ties, vector index maintenance, persistent restart, failed insert atomicity and shutdown rollback. The case assertions were the public ones. Docker and Linux resource limits were not exercised in this run.

experiments.source: Official round2 result screenshot provided by the student
experiments.output: The first submission passed MySQL, E=372.812673, and its Agent Prompt result was invalid or under review per the platform message. The second reported MySQL pass, E=296.893996 and completed Agent Prompt raw score 0. The platform showed no breakdown of write/query time, I/O or memory. The student did not personally run tests.

experiments.source: Local tool execution, tests/benchmark_search.py, compared with 8abbdc10cf527979119df1532b99c970d9b50f86
experiments.output: Three paired Windows runs, seeds 719–721, 10000 rows, 128 dimensions, 30 exact Top10 queries per group. Median previous→candidate milliseconds: high-cardinality equality 308.1→8.7, low-cardinality equality 67.8→62.0, unfiltered 1240.6→1231.1, primary key equality 2.5→2.7; durable writes 2885.3→2754.4. Log byte counts and result hashes agreed at every seed. Peak process resident memory was 73.15→73.98 MiB. This measures local process RSS and log size, not official cgroup memory or physical I/O.

experiments.source: Local tool execution, fallback and correctness checks
experiments.output: Result hashes matched with 16500 rows beyond the auxiliary index size cap. 24 exact TopK results matched independent float32 ground truth. ANN recall was 1.000 on the local fixture. Unique and compound filters, rollback, committed changes, deletion, indexed restart, and two forced process exits passed.

limitations: 本轮实现和上述实验由 Agent 执行。当前记录没有学生独立设计、解释实验或复盘的材料，也没有正式评测结果。
